thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: runtime kernel upgrade for inference runtime on Dedicated + Private. Change window: Sat 2026-04-11 02:00-04:00 UTC. Impact: short request-level stalls during kernel swap; automatic fallback to quantized variant. Please review customer-facing statuspage + email.

alex: Noted. Is this a rolling kernel swap or full pool restart?

deploy-bot: Rolling kernel swap across GPU pools (max 10% of capacity at a time). No full control-plane restart expected.

maria: Drafting comms. We'll need statuspage short + email long form. Suggest to call out expected SLO impact (<500ms extra p99 for up to 10m during swap) and fallback behavior. Also include pinning option for enterprise customers.

ryan: If we see increased 5xx, we should pin affected customers to v2.3.1 and pause the rollout. Can we add an automated canary monitor to auto-hold at 2% if p50 latency increases >100ms or error rate >0.5%?

alex: Yes, adding canary triggers. Also I'll create a reserved pin for customers flagged as 'no-upgrade' — who want to stay on current kernels. Will add rollout notes in the release doc.

lena: For product copy, mention prefix/KV cache invalidation might cause a small spike in token compute for cached sessions. Recommend we advise dev customers to expect short-lived higher token billing if they have long-running sessions.

maria: Email draft snippet (will iterate):

support-bot: ```
Status: Maintenance scheduled
When: Sat Apr 11 02:00-04:00 UTC
What: Kernel patching for inference runtime to improve latency and security
Impact: Brief increases in request latency for a subset of requests; automatic fallback to a quantized variant; no data loss
What we recommend: No action required. If you need uninterrupted behavior, request a version pin (reply to this email).
Contact: support@redwood.ai
``` 

alex: Thanks. Maria — can you add a line about rollback policy and expected follow-up notes once rollout completes? Maybe link to the release notes page and include a KB about pinning.

maria: Yep. I'll add rollback steps and a link placeholder. I'll post the final statuspage snippet here for review before publishing.

ryan: I'll wire the canary thresholds and monitor dashboards. If canary triggers, I'll tag @oncall and pause rollout; support will send immediate statuspage update.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled. To confirm publish: react :white_check_mark: and ops will publish statuspage 30 mins before window.

lena: :thumbsup:

alex: :white_check_mark:

maria: Draft ready, posting final copy in 20m.

ryan: Oncall runbook updated with rollback checklist.

support-bot: Statuspage snippet queued for 30-min pre-announce.

maria: final draft pasted below for last pass:

maria: ```
Planned maintenance: Inference runtime kernel upgrade
Window: Sat Apr 11 02:00 - 04:00 UTC
Expected impact: Short (<10m) latency variability for a subset of requests during rolling kernel swaps. Automatic fallback to compatible quantized model will maintain availability.
Customer action: No action required. To avoid upgrades, request a version pin via support. Enterprise customers will be contacted individually.
Follow-up: Post-maintenance report and release notes will be published here: <link-to-release-notes>
``` 

alex: LGTM.

maria: Publishing now to staging statuspage for review.

deploy-bot: Staging statuspage published. Will auto-publish to public 30 minutes before the window.

maria: Thanks all. I'll send the email batch and the statuspage update per schedule.

ryan: Ready on monitoring and rollback.

lena: Thanks team.
